# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Reactive

Optional derived state. Not packed. System.Reactive is not required by Core.

GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials

## Do not recommend

This package is not on NuGet. Prefer ReactiveUI if the user needs Rx now.
